source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban mobility" AND (social OR equity OR justice OR everyday OR politics)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban mobility" AND (social OR equity OR justice OR everyday OR politics),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban mobility" AND ("equity" OR "everyday" OR "justice" OR "politics" OR "social"))
